cockroachdb/cockroach#144262 (by rharding6373): cdc: issue a warning when a duplicate changefeed is created
Although it is possible for changefeeds to be created with the same destination URI, in some cases this is due to an error or typo that can be hard to detect, and can cause issues in the downstream environment. We should issue a warning when changefeeds are created for the same tables and same URI to alert users when this happens.

Jira issue: CRDB-49296

I left a few comments [2025-06-26T15:10:02Z reviewed by Copilot state=commented] ## Pull Request Overview Adds functionality to detect and warn when a new changefeed is created that duplicates an existing one (same sink URI and table set) and persists an identity hash to the job_info table for later lookup. - Computes a SHA-256 hash of the sink URI + sorted table IDs and writes it to job_info. - Queries system.jobs/job_info for matching hashes on CREATE, ALTER, and RESUME to emit a NOTICE via pgnotice. - Introduces a cluster setting (`feature.changefeed.duplicate_check.enabled`) and adds comprehensive tests for duplicate-feed detection.
